title: A commitment withdrawal penalty
hook: Two stated cases: explore the cost of an early exit in a commitment contract.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the cost of an early exit in a commitment contract affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gain, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the cost of an early exit in a commitment contract in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
